description: In every structure, the actual formula of a signed ground literal is true exactly when its atom has the selected truth sign.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.literal_truth.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (l : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Literal L) (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.literalFormula l ↔
    if l.1 = true then l.2.Realize M else ¬l.2.Realize M
